title: Research study: race rules, model advice and a full-horizon oracle instrument

supersedes.reason: v1 used an 8-step greedy oracle and sensor-seed-only families; v2 declares a full-remaining-episode finite oracle schedule and diverse plant-condition families

family_matrix.shape: 4 operating conditions x 4 physical plant conditions x 2 sensor seeds
family_matrix.roster_mapping: operation_index = floor(family_index / 8); plant_index = floor(family_index / 2) mod 4; sensor_index = family_index mod 2
operating_conditions: nominal_occupied: occupied, load_scale=1.00, generation_w=5500, temperature_delta=0, co2_delta=0, o2=0.30, humidity=0.45, pressure=72000
high_load_occupied: occupied, load_scale=1.30, generation_w=4500, temperature_delta=1.5, co2_delta=160, o2=0.27, humidity=0.55, pressure=72000
eva_transition: eva_transition, load_scale=0.75, generation_w=6000, temperature_delta=-0.5, co2_delta=-80, o2=0.25, humidity=0.40, pressure=68000
contingency: contingency, load_scale=1.20, generation_w=3500, temperature_delta=2.0, co2_delta=260, o2=0.23, humidity=0.60, pressure=70000
physical_plant_conditions: fan_degradation: fan_speed_degradation steps 32..79 at multiplier 0.95, resource_factor=0.95
laboratory_resistance: branch_resistance_increase for laboratory steps 32..79 at multiplier 1.90, resource_factor=1.00
equipment_cooling_loss: cooling_delivery_degradation for equipment_power_bay steps 32..79 at multiplier 0.85, resource_factor=0.90
sensor_conditions: sensor_seed_a: base random seed plus 1000 times family index
sensor_seed_b: base random seed plus 1000 times family index plus 17

decision_rule.oracle_horizon: episode_steps - current_state_step, evaluated separately at each decision

target_layout.columns: 8 zones x (temperature_k, pressure_pa, co2_ppm, o2_mole_fraction, relative_humidity, branch_airflow_m3_s) + (battery_soc, oxygen_store, sorbent_remaining)

metrics.safety_exposure: sum_over_steps_and_targets_of_max(0, lower - value)/scale + max(0, value - upper)/scale_on_true_plant_states

oracle_contract.schedule_space: the four frozen catalogue commands, each repeated unchanged from the current decision through the final episode step
oracle_contract.foresight: true plant state, future timeline loads, future operating modes and declared fault schedule are available only to this evidence instrument
oracle_contract.scope_limit: exact only over the declared four-action constant-command schedule; not a global optimum over arbitrary action sequences
prohibited_uses: never embedded in any demo report or browser surface as a controller
never shipped as a runtime advisor
reported only as the declared finite schedule measuring instrument of this study

expected_results.ordering_expectation: no directional result is required; the full-horizon instrument and diverse conditions replace the superseded v1 expectation
expected_results.safety_expectation: reported as measured across operating and physical-condition families
expected_results.comfort_expectation: reported as measured without a minimum passing claim
expected_results.resource_expectation: reported as measured without a directional commitment
expected_results.hmc_rejection_expectation: rejections are expected to be rare because the four catalogue commands are pre-validated; every rejection is counted

reporting_requirements: publish the full per-arm per-family results table for safety_violation_steps, safety_exposure, comfort_deviation, and resource_composite
publish gap closure with bootstrap 95 percent CI for all three continuous metrics regardless of outcome
report hmc_rejection_count and abstention_count per arm
report the operating-condition, physical-plant-condition and sensor-condition roster
state explicitly that the oracle is a measuring instrument and the results are simulation development evidence only
success_criteria.honest_negative_rule: any model worsening or non-closure is published without tuning when all hard gates pass

non_goals: no deployment qualification certification or hardware claim
no change to HMC policy contracts physics or frozen artifacts
no oracle integration into any demo or runtime advisory surface
no tuning of thresholds or metrics after observing results
no use of final-suite or validation data
no claim that the finite four-action schedule is a global optimum
